background: HSBC Holdings is the listed holding company of HSBC, one of the world's largest banks, with its main earnings in Hong Kong and the UK and a global transaction banking, wealth and trade franchise.
synthesis: As a holding company its ratings sit below the banks': A on average across two of the three main agencies, the weakest of them at A-, one on a positive outlook and one on a stable outlook, with the last move a one-notch downgrade by one of the three on 13 May 2020. Consolidated capital is strong against UK majors, with CET1 of 14.1% above the peer median and leverage of 4.9% at the median, while liquidity is mixed: LCR of 134% is in the bottom quarter and NSFR of 140% is in the top quarter. Since 30 Jun 2025 CET1 and leverage have each fallen 0.5 points and NSFR 5 points. The flagged news is management change, with the finance director's departure announced on 10 Sep 2026 and earlier items on senior job cuts.
